record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare COTTON_GUARD: ELDEGOSS (2 stars), FURFROU (3 stars), GOSSIFLEUR (1 star); all have range 1 and maxPP 100 per the unit blocks. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (shield table index).
record.summary: The caster gains a shield (raw 15/30/60 by stars; AP-scaled) and +3 raw DEF, and marks the cells in front of it (toward the cast target) with a COTTON_BALL board effect; each enemy standing there at cast time is put to sleep for a requested 1000 ms. The cotton effect also lingers on those cells.

targeting.who: caster itself (shield, DEF); enemies in the cells in front of the caster (sleep); any entity on those cells receives the board effect
targeting.note: The cast target only sets the facing direction (getCellsInFront updates pokemon.orientation). Allies standing in those cells get the COTTON_BALL effect through addBoardEffect and so fall asleep for 1000 ms via the status update, as far as the source reads; they are not hit by the direct triggerSleep call.

geometry.shape: up to three adjacent cells in front of the caster: the cell in the facing orientation and the two neighbouring orientations (range 1), on-board only

effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied: Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down for a holder (PokemonEntity.addShield); then x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost 1), x critPower if the cast crit, x0.5 if the caster is enraged, rounded (PokemonState.addShield); the shield stat is then max(0, shield + value).
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> applied (after belt, AP, crit, enraged, rounding) -> shield added; nothing is added if the caster's hp is 0. No timer or removal in this file; the shield is consumed by later damage.

effects.scaling: requested = 3 for every star count. applied by addDefense: round(3 x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if crit), then Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down for a holder, then Twist Band (no effect on a positive self-buff); def = max(0, def + value).
effects.resolution: requested 3 -> applied (after AP, crit rounding, belt) -> actual change (the floor never binds for a gain). No timer or removal appears in this file.

effects.target: each enemy in the cells in front of the caster
effects.scaling: requested 1000 ms for every star count. triggerSleep: ignored if the target is already asleep, rune-protected, skydiving, has IMMUNITY_SLEEP or ccCooldown > 0; otherwise duration x1.3 at night / x0.7 at zenith weather, halved if enraged, then the generic status duration reductions, rounded.
effects.resolution: requested 1000 -> applied duration after weather, enraged and reductions -> sleep flag true for that long; on waking ccCooldown is set to at least CC_COOLDOWN, which blocks a new sleep meanwhile. The reductions function applyStatusDurationReductions was not read.

effects.target: every on-board cell in front of the caster
effects.resolution: addBoardEffect marks each cell and gives the effect to any entity standing there (allies included) unless it holds Heavy Duty Boots; an entity that later moves onto such a cell gains it too. An entity with the effect that is not asleep falls asleep for 1000 ms on its next status update and the effect is removed from that entity (not from the cell).

starBehavior.note: only the shield table is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value 120 is not reachable at the bare factory star counts of these units. DEF +3 and sleep 1000 ms do not vary by star. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Only on-board cells among the (up to) three in front are affected; with the caster at an edge fewer cells apply. The caster's own cell is not included. Cells are marked whether or not they hold an entity.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes in the strategy. Shields and DEF stack additively; the COTTON_BALL cell mark is a set, so recasting does not duplicate it. Sleep is not re-applied to an entity already asleep or inside the crowd-control cooldown.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: shield 15/30/60 (1/2/3 stars), DEF +3, sleep 1000 ms. Shield added = round(raw x belt x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor, halved if enraged); DEF applied = round(3 x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor) then belt; sleep duration after weather, enraged and status reductions. None is computed here for a specific caster or target.
